channel_access_application_not_found: No application with that id exists in this server.
channel_access_applied: Your application was submitted. You'll hear back once members have voted.
channel_access_apply_dm_closed: {0}, I could not DM you. Allow direct messages from members of this server and try again.
channel_access_apply_failed: Could not submit your application. The review channel may be missing or unreachable.
channel_access_apply_intro: Applying for {0}. I will ask you {1} question(s) here. Reply to each one with a message and your reply is your answer.
channel_access_apply_length: Your answer must be at least {0} characters and at most {1} characters. Please send it again.
channel_access_apply_optional_hint: This one is optional. Reply `skip` to leave it blank.
channel_access_apply_timeout: Your application timed out because you did not reply in time. Start again whenever you are ready.
channel_access_blacklist_added: {0} can no longer apply for channel access.
channel_access_blacklist_not_found: That user is not blocked from applying.
channel_access_blacklist_removed: {0} can apply for channel access again.
channel_access_gate_created: Applications for {0} are now open. Approved applicants get {1}.
channel_access_gate_created_direct: Applications for {0} are now open. Approved applicants get added to the channel directly.
channel_access_gate_exists: That channel already has an access gate. Use caconfig to change it.
channel_access_no_gate: That channel does not have an access gate.
channel_access_no_gates: This server has no access gates set up yet.
channel_access_no_questions: This gate has no questions, so applicants are submitted straight away.
channel_access_no_votes: No votes have been cast yet.
channel_access_panel_body: This channel is invite only. React with 📝 below to apply and I will ask you the questions in your DMs. The members already inside will vote on it.
channel_access_panel_failed: Could not post the panel in that channel.
channel_access_question_limit: A gate can only have {0} questions.
channel_access_question_missing: There is no question at that position.
channel_access_setting_unknown: There is no gate setting called `{0}`. Run the command with no setting to see the list.
channel_access_settings_list:
`enabled` true/false
`approvals` number of approving votes needed
`denials` number of denying votes needed
`votehours` how long a vote stays open, 0 for no limit
`onexpiry` deny / majority / stayopen
`reviewchannel` channel applications post in
`logchannel` channel decisions are logged to
`voterrole` role allowed to vote
`pingrole` role pinged on new applications
`anonymousapplicant` true/false
`anonymousvotes` true/false
`allowabstain` true/false
`minaccountage` days
`minserverage` days
`reapplycooldown` hours
`dmondecision` true/false
channel_access_vote_instructions: React with ✅ to approve or ❌ to deny. Take your reaction back to remove your vote.
channel_access_vote_instructions_abstain: React with ✅ to approve, ❌ to deny or 🤷 to abstain. Take your reaction back to remove your vote.
channel_access_vote_not_eligible: Only members who already have access to that channel can vote on it.
channel_access_votes_hidden: Vote details are hidden for this gate.
